reviewers.summary: The entry is mostly sound. The issues are an intransitive use with no pattern or example, a few doubtful labels and collocations (the "throw a dinner" example, the informal label on tantrum), a regularized "throwed" learner error, a fact stated twice in two ways (throw away), a mark-up slip in the adaptation note, and missing idioms (throw in the towel, throw light/doubt on).

There are minor notes-discipline and formatting issues in `learner_errors`, `adaptation`, and `consistency` (duplicate coverage of *throw* vs. *throw away*/*out*, an elementary inflection error in `learner_errors`, and single asterisks around word mentions in `adaptation.semantic`).
